record.label: Raw <1e-8 mathematical acceleration (15 live derivation lanes)
record.summary: Theory-only campaign: fifteen concurrent derivation lanes seek a signed cubic + broad variance + quartic/rest mechanism that preserves >85.624% of the F2J-to-oracle gap at O(n^2) memory and O(Ln^3) or lower work. Running agents are orchestration state, not empirical evidence.
record.terminal_criterion: Produce a non-double-counted source/consumer stack with task correlation >0.9253 (or component-weighted equivalent), deployable complexity, and a bounded remainder; otherwise close every proposed family by proof/cost.

evidence.claim: Persistent derivation ledger and live-lane map

record.goal_path_summary: The exact-state ladder proves the architecture can cross 1e-8 only with a joint variance, signed-cubic, and quartic/rest correction. These lanes attack each mathematical source, its exact consumer, double-counting, and deployability in parallel.
